title: Cascading levels
text: One named listbox per level, from country to state to city.

title: Lazy children
text: Load a level when it opens, with a loading state, abort on close, and retry.

title: Search across levels
text: Type to list matching paths such as India / Karnataka / Bengaluru.

title: Single or multiple
text: One path in the trigger, or several as removable chips; any level with changeOnSelect.

title: Keyboard complete
text: Arrows within and between levels, reading-direction aware, Escape to close.
